tool_guide:
## Tool guide (compact)
explore→plan→pack→edit→compile→map_review→done.
First step: plan with 4–8 path:Symbol. After pack: prefer edit. Tools max 4; refetch Truncated with path:A-B or #tail.
JSON only. edit hunks need unique multiline search. New API: edit .hpp decl + .cpp def together.
clarify only if Instruction has no concrete src/ path.
| tool | arg |
| get_code_of | path:Symbol|#tail|A-B |
| file_outline | path |
| search | needles |
| headers_of | path |
| sibling_of | path (.cpp↔.hpp) |
system_extra:
## Sibling API rule
When adding a new function/method:
1) Always include a declaration hunk in the .hpp/.h sibling AND a definition hunk in the .cpp in the SAME action=edit (multiple hunks[]).
2) Use tool sibling_of on the path if unsure of the twin file.
3) Compile undeclared/undefined ⇒ next edit MUST include the missing sibling hunk.

Use sibling_of for twin paths.

user_overlays.edit: sibling_of then edit both hpp and cpp in one action.
user_overlays.pack: If adding API, pack should include sibling header; then edit both files.
